source_correctness.reason: Core primary quotations/code/history mostly verify; consequential guarantees, tag-baseline sequence, auto-publication/byte-access inference, and Archivematica negative source scope do not.

completeness.reason: All declared artifact sections assessed; actual proposal does not close failed-storage restoration, durable DB/tree reconciliation, or rights-change/delivery conditions. Alternatives and media-policy research shallow.

breadth.reason: Multiple preservation/catalog risk domains researched; only two concrete architecture families supported. Three alternatives and media formats mostly synthesis. Same-page repeated verification is depth, not added discovery breadth.
breadth.candidate_credit_basis: Substantive supported discoveries, not labels/files/citation counts.
